scope: Only two source-image-reviewed ungraded study retypes for TNPSC 2022 Group II/IIA General Studies. The symbol series uses Unicode lookalikes for some printed glyphs, not verified verbatim. The number grid is rendered as accessible text. Never use this as an official final key.

questions.text:
Use the following printed symbol series (editorial Unicode reading):
2 P J @ 8 $ L B 1 V # Q 6 δ G W 9 K C D 3 © • £ 5 F R 7 A Y 4

questions.note: Official PDF page 28 shows symbol-series Q139 and options A–E. OCR-sensitive glyphs such as δ, •, £ and © have editorial Unicode approximations; source scan is authoritative. No key inferred.
